_doc: The type guide's numbers in one place (docs/look/TYPE_GUIDE.md, PICKED 2026-10-30; docs/look/type/PLEASANT.md; docs/look/LAYOUT.md section 1). Read by src/lib/captions2 (the drawing: tones, halo, glow, motion) and by scripts/captions2/build_captions.py (the recipes: sizes, rows, seats; the checks). Px at 1080 x 1920, y down; times at 60 fps. Change a number here, never in the code; the guide wins over this file.
_lead: a word pops this many frames (at fps) before its start: text a hair ahead of the sound reads as in sync (guide header)

step._: a two-line group's second line starts this far right of the first (R1: 80-140; tightened only when the frame forces it)

frame._: the type frame (guide c): all ink inside; x 96-860 below y 840; ink in the band stays at y <= 585

dark._: dusk and night skies (video 4's whole film): warm white running words with the dark halo; the lit hand in the windows' honey light with the golden glow over a thin dark halo

light._: day and light dusk skies: deep plum ink, no halo unless the field varies (haloOnLight); the lit hand keeps the plum with the gentle warm halo

styles._: size px, weight (null = the tone's running weight: 300 dark, 400 light), track em, lit (the lit hand: the tone's accent with its glow, and the bloom), tuck (a number's comma: [gap after the figures, gap after the comma] in em, ink to ink)

motion._: frames at 60 fps (guide d). pop: 1 frame, none. soft pop (calm beats): opacity over 3, scale 0.98 -> 1 over 6, ease-out cubic. bloom (the lit hand): the glow 0 -> full and the swell 0.96 -> 1 over 8, ease-out cubic (the stills' 1 - (1 - f/8)^3: 2 of 8 frames = 58 %), about the word's baseline centre. soft out (a sentence end before a pause >= 0.4 s): opacity over 3, ease-in.

recipes._: rows: baseline, place (anchor start / end / middle at x, or the group's seat), style; a seat recipe sets 1 row at 455 or 2 at its pair. The builder writes every group's rows resolved from here.

R6.name: the phrase lettered into the open space

R7.name: the word placed in the world
